changes: NOTHING OF THE VENDOR TEXT WAS CHANGED. The manufacturer serves this model as a text file, frozen byte-for-byte under vendor/; the whole file (model text and the vendor's own comment block, 994 bytes) is appended below a header of our own, and below it a comment block and ONE line '+ KF=1e-13 AF=1.4' (ADR-057) that continues the .MODEL card and overrides the vendor's KF=0 AF=1 (last value wins, measured by the [flicker] check). No parameter removed, rounded, reordered or 'corrected'; the model NAME is left as served (Qmje243). Verifiable: diff <(grep -v '^\*' <vendor file>) <(grep -v '^\*' <this file>) shows the KF/AF line only. The vendor file uses CRLF and our header LF: the assembled file has MIXED line endings on purpose (limitations #39); it was assembled in binary by docs/preamp/data/2026-10-29/L55/modelli/costruisci_modelli.py, which asserts the vendor bytes are present unchanged.
reason: NC-056 (L55), T7 (ADR-016). notes: INSIDE every published window of onsemi MJE243/D Rev. 17 (Dec 2024), ngspice 47, set temp = 25: hFE 131.128 at 200 mA / VCE 1 V (40 min, 180 max), 56.914 at 1 A (15 min); fT 59.933 MHz at 100 mA, 10 V, ftest 10 MHz (40 min; |hfe| x ftest, the datasheet's definition); C_ob 29.154 pF at 10 V, 0.1 MHz (50 max; Fig. 7 ~30 pF). Locked +-0.5 % by tb_mje243(). At the follower point (20 mA, VCE 15 V): hFE 377, Vbe 0.626 V, Cpi 1.70 nF, Cmu 21 pF, fT 88 MHz (unity crossing); the MJE15032 under the same script: hFE 103, Vbe 0.571 V, Cpi 8.09 nF, Cmu 64 pF, fT 12 MHz. THE MODEL WAS WRITTEN BY A CONTRACTOR (MODPEX / Symmetry Design Systems, Jan 22 2003, PSpice format) and onsemi distributes it; recorded, not hidden. The datasheet specifies nothing at 20 mA. Since ADR-057 the model carries the declared flicker bound KF=1e-13 AF=1.4 (a bound, not a fit; no curve exists for a power bipolar). ngspice 47 does not converge the C_ob deck with the emitter on 1 TOhm for this model: the recipe uses 1 GOhm. Orderable part: MJE243G (Active on onsemi's page, 2026-10-29); the bare MJE243 is Obsolete.
